reconcile.note: Gill harmonizes the dates by supposing Nebuzaradan left Riblah on the seventh but did not reach or burn Jerusalem until the tenth.

discrepancy.emptyNote: This tension is catalogued in the project's sources, but its public-domain survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, to Jerusalem.
sides.verseText: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, to Jerusalem.
